projects.name: piri
projects.description: Moves a stateful app to another Kubernetes cluster without losing a byte, and proves it. Volumes converge over live rsync, then a gated checklist walks the freeze: every irreversible step needs recorded proof before it can advance, and the target needs only a namespace-scoped Role. End-to-end tested against two kind clusters on every push.

projects.name: Flight Recorder (fdr)
projects.description: git blame tells you who, fdr tells you why. A local-first provenance tool for AI-assisted codebases: it joins coding-agent session transcripts with git history into an append-only ledger committed with the code. fdr why <file>:<line> returns the originating task, the agent's stated reasoning and the commit. It runs offline and gives the same answer every time, with no model in the loop.
